findings.title: Couldn't confirm: VOC (air quality)
findings.detail: VOC lower than SCAQMD 1168 requires (250 g/L: the Rule 1168 architectural sealant limit; the number comes from the rule, not the spec).
findings.why_it_matters: Without confirmed low VOC, we can’t be sure the sealant meets air quality rules that protect workers and occupants.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: astm g21 rating
findings.detail: Firestopping materials shall have mold and mildew resistance rating of zero(0) in accordance with ASTM G21.
findings.why_it_matters: If mold resistance isn’t verified, the sealant could fail in damp areas, leading to health risks and costly rework.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: Temperature rating (T)
findings.detail: Both quoted ratings are needed for this comparison.
findings.why_it_matters: We need both temperature ratings to confirm the sealant will hold up during a fire — guessing isn’t safe on site.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: Test standards
findings.detail: Tested in accordance with ASTM E814, ASTM E119 or UL 1479.
findings.why_it_matters: Without proof of proper fire testing, we can’t trust the sealant will stop flames and smoke from spreading through floor or wall gaps.

findings.title: Data sheet is out of date
findings.detail: The submitted sheet (undated) differs from the current source (January / 2026) on: Highest service temperature.
findings.why_it_matters: An outdated data sheet might not reflect the product’s real performance today, risking use of a material that doesn’t meet current specs.

### Highlights

* Firestop tested for through penetration applications for up to 3 hours in accordance with ASTM E 814 (UL 1479) and CAN/ULC S115
* Sealant designed to help minimize sound transfer
* Water-based and paintable sealant provides easy application and clean-up
* Exceptional adhesion for long-term performance
* Applied with conventional caulking equipment with excellent caulk rate
* Sag-resistant properties offer clean application as well as strong adhesion
* Sealant is re-enterable and repairable
* Fire resistance tested for static construction joint systems in accordance with ASTM E 1966 (UL 2079)
